title: 味真书屋 Weizhen Shuwu
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 濂溪乐处
evidence.excerpt_zh: 濓溪樂處之南為彚萬總春之廟正殿為蕃育羣芳五楹殿東北樓為香逺益清樓西為樂天和為味真書屋又西為池水共心月同明廟東沿山徑出為普濟橋（圓明園册）臣等謹按彚萬總春之廟以祀花神殿樓諸額皆皇上御書池水共心月同明額世宗御書
evidence.summary: South of 濓溪樂處: the flower-spirit temple 彚萬總春之廟, with the five-bay 蕃育羣芳, 香逺益清, 樂天和, 味真書屋, 池水共心月同明 and the 普濟橋.

evidence.title: 味真书屋: 乾隆三十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十五年 (1770), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.249 item (1), under 味真书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 曲转回廊处，明窗浄几陈。琴尊亦弗藉，翰墨雅相亲。汲古以时懋，居今勉日新。诗书有真味，知味㝎何人。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味真书屋, 1770, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 味真书屋
evidence.locator: v3 p.149, under 汇万总春之庙; source ref 10-654
evidence.excerpt_zh: 曲转回廊处，明窗净几陈。琴尊亦弗藉，翰墨雅宜亲。汲古以时懋，居今勉日新。诗书有真味，知味定何人。
evidence.summary: Poem 味真书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 汇万总春之庙.

evidence.title: 味真书屋: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.249 item (2), under 味真书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 邺侯三万巻夸富，四库而今望若洋。试问屋中味真者，真知其味在何章。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味真书屋, 1774, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 味真书屋
evidence.locator: v3 p.150, under 汇万总春之庙; source ref 12-528
evidence.excerpt_zh: 邺侯三万卷夸富，四库而今望若洋。试问屋中味真者，真知其味在何章。
evidence.summary: Poem 味真书屋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1774, filed by the editors under 汇万总春之庙.

evidence.title: 味真书屋: 乾隆五十七年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十七年 (1792), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.249 item (7), under 味真书屋
evidence.excerpt_zh:
书屋称味真，味真讵易语。奚祇工点窜，实贵絜规矩。行苟勿合言，虚车饰徒汝。龆龄至耄
耋，岂非日里许。真味真得乎，自嘲识愧所。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 味真书屋, 1792, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 味真书屋
evidence.locator: from p.249, under 濂溪乐处
evidence.summary: 味真书屋: 7 dated items, 1770-1792, of which 7 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: reading. First dated 1770, last dated 1792.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 汇万总春之庙
evidence.summary: The flower-god temple garden on the south shore of 濂溪乐处, from early Qianlong: five-bay 蕃育群芳, tower with plaques 涵虚朗鉴 and 香远益清, 乐天和, 味真书屋, an open hall 池水共心月同明, and the boat-shaped 宝莲航.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
